tool.name: Split by Barcode Marker

param.name: input_collection
param.label: 10X Data Output Collection
param.help: A list collection of pools/samples; each pool is a list containing the barcodes, genes, and matrix files for that pool.

param.name: sample1_name
param.label: Sample 1 name (barcode marker: GT)
param.help: Custom name for sample with GT at positions 8-9

param.name: sample2_name
param.label: Sample 2 name (barcode marker: CA)
param.help: Custom name for sample with CA at positions 8-9

param.name: sample3_name
param.label: Sample 3 name (barcode marker: TC)
param.help: Custom name for sample with TC at positions 8-9

param.name: sample4_name
param.label: Sample 4 name (barcode marker: AG)
param.help: Custom name for sample with AG at positions 8-9

tool.help:
**Splits STARsolo/10X output by barcode marker (positions 8-9)**
This tool demultiplexes multiplexed single-cell RNA-seq data based on barcode overhang sequences embedded at positions 8-9 of the cell barcode.
**Input:** A nested (list:list) collection of pools, each containing the barcodes, genes, and matrix files for that pool (e.g. barcodes.tsv, genes.tsv, matrix.tsv).
**Mapping:** - GT → Sample 1 (default: OB1) - CA → Sample 2 (default: OB2) - TC → Sample 3 (default: OB3) - AG → Sample 4 (default: OB4)
**Output:** A single nested collection mirroring the input structure, with an additional level per split sample:
::
10X_data_output (collection) pool1 OB1: barcodes.tsv.gz, genes.tsv.gz, matrix.mtx.gz OB2: ... pool2 ...
Plus a combined summary log listing cell counts per pool/sample/marker.
